title: Camera styles when switching (0.9.169)
intro: Release the pawn, Reset Scripts. Party around you. Press End (or click both sticks) to start.

steps.text: ESTABLISH: switch to pawns and back a few times (some behind you or far off).
steps.each_frame:
if not G_tslog then
  G_tslog = true
  local td = sdk.find_type_definition("app.TimeSkipManager")
  local log = {}
  for _, m in ipairs(td:get_methods()) do
    local n = m:get_name()
    if n == "requestTimeSkip" or n == "request" or n == "requestPlayerWarp" or n == "requestOxcartWarp" then
      local np = m:get_num_params()
      local pnames = {}
      pcall(function() for _, pt in ipairs(m:get_param_types()) do pnames[#pnames+1] = pt:get_full_name() end end)
      sdk.hook(m, function(args)
        if #log >= 40 then return end
        local e = { m = n, params = pnames, a = {} }
        for i = 3, 2 + np do e.a[#e.a+1] = sdk.to_int64(args[i]) end
        pcall(function() local tm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.TimeManager"); e.clock = { tm:call("get_InGameDay"), tm:call("get_InGameHour"), tm:call("get_InGameMinute") } end)
        pcall(function() local a4 = sdk.to_managed_object(args[6]); e.action = a4 and a4:get_type_definition():get_full_name() or "nil" end)
        log[#log+1] = e
        pcall(json.dump_file, "test_guide/ts_log.json", log)
      end, function(r) return r end)
    end
  end
end

steps.text: BIRD'S-EYE: the same. The camera should rise into the sky, then fly down to them.
INSTANT: the same; it should cut like before.
Camera back to Establish. LAST: pass some time the game's way (sleep at a campfire or similar). Press End when the game is back.
Done. Tell Claude which style you liked, and that you slept.
